title: Rules.
bodyText: The director, in consultation with the council, private agencies, users of services under this part, and other interested parties, may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to carry out the purposes of this part.
bodyHtml: [§321-354]  Rules.  The director, in consultation with the council, private agencies, users of services under this part, and other interested parties, may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to carry out the purposes of this part. [L 1989, c 107, pt of §2]
